why: Issue #633. The over-correction: the rotate buttons' PRESS styling is pulled into `@media (hover: hover)` along with their hover. A touch device matches no hovering pointer, so a finger holding a rotate button would get no pressed treatment inside the query, which is exactly where a hold needs visible feedback. Killed by the rotate-button case's assertion that `:active` is not in the hover block.
killedBy: hover treatment on the UI kit primitives (issue #392) keeps the rotate buttons' hover behind the pointer query, and their press outside it (issue #633)
